literature.summary: A cluster of genes up in DTPs but not after acute treatment stayed up through washout and was enriched for EMT and wound-healing terms.
A cluster that fell after acute treatment and recovered through washout tracked regrowth and was enriched for cell cycle and DNA replication genes.
Antioxidant programs were associated with persister proliferative capacity.

hypotheses.text: Removing the acute stress component makes persister signatures separate persisters from acute treatment better in an unseen cell line.
hypotheses.metric: mean held-out AUROC, DTP vs acute

hypotheses.text: Persister-specific signature genes replicate in the held-out cell line at least as often as naive treated-vs-control genes.
hypotheses.metric: fraction of signature genes significant with the same sign in the held-out line

hypotheses.text: Persister programmes differ in how they behave after drug withdrawal.
hypotheses.note: Post hoc: only 4 genes reverse reproducibly in 3 or more lines; reversal is mostly line-specific. H1975: 139 reversing genes, HCC2935: 618 reversing genes, HCC827: 154 reversing genes, PC9: 1392 reversing genes

hypotheses.text: Regulatory inference adds information beyond expression alone.
hypotheses.note: Activity is inferred from target expression, so this is supporting, not independent, evidence.

hypotheses.text: Some strong persister markers lack evidence that they are needed for persister formation.

hypotheses.metric: PC9 single cells under osimertinib (GSE275199): cycling fraction and bimodality of the persister score
hypotheses.note: 2864 drug-exposed PC9 cells; 23% in a cycling state; delta BIC for two vs one component 21. Drug exposure inferred from MAPK output (hashtags not public).

hypotheses.text: The persister-specific signature, frozen from cell lines, marks residual tumour cells in patient-derived xenografts after six weeks of osimertinib.
hypotheses.metric: mean AUROC, residual vs untreated tumour cells, two PDXs (GSE243562)
hypotheses.note: Post hoc, added after the first run; signatures frozen before these data were read. Both transfer in vivo (naive 0.71, stress-removed 0.70), so removing stress gives no extra edge here.

hypotheses.text: The stress-removed signature marks persisters equally in G1, S and G2, so cycling persisters carry it too.
hypotheses.metric: smallest / largest day-28 shift across sorted phases (GSE335846); 1 means identical
hypotheses.note: Post hoc, added after the first run. Shifts per phase: naive G1 +2.32, naive G2 +0.98, naive S +0.69, persister G1 +2.04, persister G2 +1.93, persister S +1.75

hypotheses.text: Evidence-aware ranking places literature-supported genes higher than expression-only ranking.
hypotheses.metric: rank percentile (lower is better) of genes with published perturbation records
hypotheses.note: Tiny, literature-biased reference set. Not a validation.

cell_cycle_sorted.note: Values are the depositors' normalised log expression, averaged over transcripts per gene.
